confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'that is effectively enough to confirm the battery has failed and needs replacing. There is little point in further checks'

rationale: The assistant never established the model (SV11/V7) or asked whether the stop is pulsing or clean. It repeated the Normal-mode test request across turns, then declared the battery confirmed and told the customer to skip further checks and buy a replacement. The ground truth says charger or body faults cannot be excluded without a swap test or Dyson diagnosis, and the assistant never mentioned Dyson support or the charger contact. It also treated cut-outs on Max as normal when the customer reported cut-outs within seconds and in handheld mode too, which suggests a fault.
